answer_decisions.exact_final:
The specific hereditary title adopted by the head of the royal family historically associated with the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple is **Maharaja of Travancore** (also referred to as the **Titular Maharaja of Travancore**).

This title is held by the supreme guardian or trustee of the temple. The connection to **Vilwamangalam Swamiyar** is established through his role in consecrating the deity at the Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple in Thiruvananthapuram and subsequently consecrating **Karthyayani Devi** at the **Karthyayani Devi Temple in Cherthala**, where he was traveling back. The head of the royal family has historically been associated with the administration and supervision of the temple, often receiving concurrence from the Ettara Yogam before assuming the title and performing anointing rituals at the temple.
answer_decisions.adopted_answer: Maharaja of Travancore／Titular Maharaja of Travancore
